key.name: add-workspace
key.summary: Add a workspace right after the current one and go there

key.name: remove-workspace
key.summary: Remove the current workspace (its windows move to the previous one)

key.name: focus-toggle
key.summary: Start or stop a focus session

key.name: bar-look
key.summary: Look of the top bar: classic, manga, glass, islands or flat (looks.js)

key.name: accent-pulse
key.summary: Breathe the accent on the active workspace and the focused window's border after a switch (accent.js)

key.name: next-look
key.summary: Switch the top bar to the next look

key.name: focus-minutes
key.summary: Length of a focus block in minutes

key.name: break-minutes
key.summary: Break after a focus block in minutes (0 = no break)

key.name: focus-phase
key.summary: Running phase: '' (idle), 'focus' or 'break' (written by the shell only)

key.name: focus-end
key.summary: Unix time the running phase ends (0 while paused)

key.name: focus-left
key.summary: Seconds left while paused (0 = not paused)

key.name: focus-total
key.summary: Length of the running phase in seconds

key.name: focus-started
key.summary: Unix time the current focus block began

key.name: focus-owns-dnd
key.summary: The focus timer switched notification banners off and will switch them back on
